meta.disclaimer: This matrix provides technical controls for readiness assessment. It does NOT constitute legal certification or guarantee of compliance.

controls.title: AI Literacy Measures
controls.provision: Providers and deployers shall adopt measures to ensure, to their best extent, a sufficient level of AI literacy of their personnel and other persons dealing with the operation and use of AI systems on their behalf.
controls.claim: Organization has implemented AI literacy measures for personnel using AI systems

applicability.condition: Personnel who operate or use AI systems on behalf of the organization

evidence_required: AI system inventory identifying personnel who use AI
Training policy or procedure document
Training records (attendance, completion certificates)
Employee acknowledgment of AI usage policies
product_evidence: Training attendance log in SQLite database
controls.pmi_question: I dipendenti che utilizzano sistemi AI hanno ricevuto formazione specifica sul caso d'uso?
quiz_questions: Quali dati NON devi mai inserire su ChatGPT o altre AI pubbliche?
Quando devi informare un cliente che sta interagendo con un'AI?
Cosa fare se un'AI produce un risultato che sembra errato o discriminatorio?
controls.check_description: Verify presence of training completion records in database and policy documents

readiness_states.EVIDENCE_PRESENT: Training records exist for all identified personnel

controls.remediation: Assign CORSI_AI_ACT_DIPENDENTI.md module to relevant departments and track completion
controls.software_limitations: Cannot verify actual comprehension or quality of training; only tracks completion evidence
controls.legal_disclaimer: Training attests effort toward AI literacy but does NOT constitute legal certification of compliance with Art. 4

controls.title: Prohibition of Manipulative AI Practices
controls.provision: The placing on the market, putting into service or use of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person's consciousness is prohibited.
controls.claim: Organization does not use AI systems with subliminal manipulative techniques
evidence_required: AI system inventory with intended purpose documentation
Technical review confirming absence of subliminal techniques
Vendor declarations for third-party AI systems
controls.pmi_question: Il sistema AI utilizza tecniche che agiscono oltre la coscienza dell'utente (es. stimoli subliminali)?
controls.check_description: Requires human review of AI system functionality and intended purpose
controls.remediation: Immediately cease use of any AI system employing subliminal techniques; consult legal counsel
controls.software_limitations: Automated scanning cannot detect subliminal techniques; requires human expert review
controls.legal_disclaimer: This is a legal prohibition. Violation may result in fines up to EUR 35M or 7% global turnover.

controls.title: Prohibition of Social Scoring
controls.provision: The use of AI systems by public authorities or on their behalf for social scoring is prohibited.
controls.claim: Organization does not engage in social scoring practices

applicability.condition: Especially relevant for organizations contracting with public authorities

evidence_required: AI system inventory with use case documentation
Assessment of whether any system performs social scoring
Public authority contract review (if applicable)
controls.pmi_question: Il sistema valuta o classifica persone in base al comportamento sociale, status economico, o caratteristiche personali?
controls.check_description: Requires assessment of AI system outputs and decision criteria

readiness_states.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Scoring system exists but purpose unclear

controls.remediation: Cease any social scoring activities; redesign system to avoid prohibited classification
controls.software_limitations: Cannot automatically determine if scoring constitutes 'social scoring' under Art. 5
controls.legal_disclaimer: Social scoring prohibition carries highest penalties. Seek legal counsel if uncertain.

controls.title: Transparency for AI Interaction Disclosure
controls.provision: Providers shall design and develop AI systems in such a way that natural persons are informed when they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the circumstances.
controls.claim: AI systems clearly disclose their artificial nature to users

applicability.deployer_obligation: Art. 26 - Deployers must ensure transparency when using high-risk AI
applicability.condition: AI systems designed to interact directly with natural persons
applicability.exception: When interaction is obvious from circumstances

evidence_required: UI/UX design documentation showing disclosure mechanisms
Sample user interactions demonstrating AI disclosure
Chatbot greeting scripts including AI identification
product_evidence: Code scan for disclosure strings in chatbot interfaces
controls.pmi_question: Gli utenti sono informati quando stanno interagendo con un'AI invece che con una persona?
controls.check_description: Scan code for common disclosure patterns; manual UI review required

readiness_states.DISCLOSURE_PRESENT: Clear AI disclosure visible in user interface
readiness_states.DISCLOSURE_INADEQUATE: Disclosure present but unclear or hidden

controls.remediation: Implement clear disclosure at beginning of interaction: 'I am an AI assistant...'
controls.software_limitations: Cannot evaluate UX quality or whether disclosure is 'obvious from circumstances'
controls.legal_disclaimer: Transparency violations may result in fines up to EUR 7.5M or 1% global turnover

controls.title: Deepfake Labeling Requirement
controls.provision: Providers of AI systems generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content shall apply machine-readable markers indicating artificial generation.
controls.claim: AI-generated content (deepfakes) is properly labeled with machine-readable markers

applicability.deployer_obligation: Deployers should preserve markers when possible
applicability.condition: AI systems generating synthetic media (audio, image, video, text)

evidence_required: Technical implementation of C2PA or similar watermarking standard
Metadata preservation in generated content
Process for maintaining markers through content lifecycle
product_evidence: Sample generated files with metadata analysis
controls.pmi_question: I contenuti generati dall'AI (immagini, video, audio, testo) includono marcatori leggibili che indicano l'origine artificiale?
controls.check_description: Check for presence of watermarking libraries; analyze sample output metadata

readiness_states.MARKERS_ABSENT: No markers found in generated content
readiness_states.UNCLEAR: Unable to determine marker presence automatically

controls.remediation: Implement C2PA standard or equivalent machine-readable watermarking
controls.software_limitations: Cannot verify marker robustness against removal attempts
controls.legal_disclaimer: Deepfake labeling is mandatory for most commercial uses since 2 August 2026

controls.title: Secret Leak Detection
controls.provision: API keys, passwords, and credentials must not be hardcoded in source code
controls.claim: No secrets or credentials are exposed in source code
evidence_required: .gitignore includes .env files
No hardcoded API keys in source
Environment variable usage for credentials
controls.check_description: Regex-based scanning for secret patterns (sk-, Bearer, password=, etc.)

readiness_states.NO_SECRETS_FOUND: Scan completed with no secrets detected

controls.remediation: Move secrets to environment variables; add .env to .gitignore; rotate exposed credentials

standard_mapping.OWASP_LLM_TOP10: LLM01 - Prompt Injection, LLM06 - Sensitive Information Disclosure

controls.legal_disclaimer: This is a security best practice, not a direct AI Act requirement. However, Art. 15 cybersecurity obligations may apply to high-risk systems.

controls.title: SQL Injection Prevention
controls.provision: Database queries must use parameterized statements to prevent SQL injection
controls.claim: Application uses safe query patterns without string concatenation vulnerabilities
evidence_required: Use of parameterized queries or ORM
No string concatenation in SQL statements
controls.check_description: Pattern detection for unsafe query construction
controls.remediation: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries or prepared statements
controls.legal_disclaimer: Critical for Art. 15 cybersecurity compliance in high-risk systems
